'''Peter Wynn''' (1931{{mdash}}2017) was an English mathematician. His main achievements concern [[approximation theory]] – in particular the theory of [[Padé approximant]]s – and its application in [[Numerical mathematics|numerical methods]] for improving the [[rate of convergence]] of [[sequence]]s of [[real number]]s.
